description: This file defines a WPF UserControl named MemoryListItem for a calculator application, handling UI interactions such as pointer events and swipe actions related to memory operations.

classes.name: MemoryListItem
classes.description: A UserControl representing a memory item in the calculator, with UI logic for pointer hover and swipe actions.

methods.name: Model
methods.description: Property for binding the MemoryItemViewModel to the control.

methods.name: OnPointerEntered
methods.description: Handles pointer enter events to show memory buttons when using mouse or pen.

methods.name: OnPointerExited
methods.description: Handles pointer exit events to hide memory buttons.

methods.name: OnMemoryAddButtonClicked
methods.description: Invokes the MemoryAdd method on the model when the add button is clicked.

methods.name: OnClearButtonClicked
methods.description: Invokes the Clear method on the model when the clear button is clicked.

methods.name: OnMemorySubtractButtonClicked
methods.description: Invokes the MemorySubtract method on the model when the subtract button is clicked.

methods.name: OnClearSwipeInvoked
methods.description: Handles swipe action to clear memory.

methods.name: OnMemoryAddSwipeInvoked
methods.description: Handles swipe action to add to memory.

methods.name: OnMemorySubtractSwipeInvoked
methods.description: Handles swipe action to subtract from memory.
